recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2026-65400, a 9.8-CVSS macOS authentication bypass, to its KEV catalog on August 18, confirming active exploitation. No patch yet.
XCSSET v40, a macOS malware targeting Xcode developers, has resurfaced with 17 modules, including a Chrome hijacking backdoor and Telegram trojanizer, after months of dormancy.
Apple released emergency patches for two zero-days exploited in the wild alongside the beta rollout of end-to-end encrypted RCS messaging for iOS and macOS.
